name: Rounded cube module - faster than minkowski!

captions.detailed: A 3D render of a solid, rounded cube with smooth, spherical corners and edges. The object is symmetrical along all three axes, presenting a uniform, clean geometric shape with no internal holes or external protrusions. The rounding radius is consistent across all edges, creating a soft, tactile aesthetic suitable for hand-held parts or enclosure corners.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric rounded cube module in OpenSCAD that uses a fast-rendering alternative to the minkowski operator. The script should allow the user to specify the overall dimensions (size_x, size_y, size_z), the facet count (facets), and the rounding radius (rounding_radius).
captions.factory: The script defines a module `rounded_cube` that takes dimensions for the x, y, and z axes, along with a facet count and rounding radius. It positions eight individual sphere primitives at each of the eight outer corners of the intended cube volume, offsetting them inward by the rounding radius. It then wraps these eight spheres using the `hull()` operator to generate a solid, smooth-edged 3D rounded cube.
